title: A park's own photo, looked up first when someone opens its page
why: A fix in place of card photos (#205). Jason's screenshot, 2026-11-19: Lyman Lake State Park still showed a stock photo of a shopping street. The finder reaches 15 places an hour, national parks first, so a page someone opens could wait days. Now a qualifying listing opened without a photo goes to the front of the next run: same finder, same pace, same rules (a private place is never looked up). No new tables.
